title: When You Are Lost
label: ch:bn-when-you-are-lost
canDo: I can report what I think with যে, put one event beside another in time with যখন … তখন, and ask somebody to say it again, slowly, when I have not followed.

payoff.summary: A learner who has stopped following says so and gets the sentence back: I do not understand, say it again, slowly — assembled out of না from chapter twenty-seven and two words the book taught in chapters seven and eleven — and then reports an opinion with যে and places it in time with যখন … তখন.
payoff.note: Two of the four items introduce no new vocabulary at all: the repair sentences are assemblies of words already in the book, which is why they were missing rather than hard.
